<usr>Implement topological sort algorithm</usr>
<bot><thought>
Goal: Topological sort of DAG.
Step 1: Compute in-degree for all vertices.
Step 2: Collect vertices with in-degree 0 in queue.
Step 3: Process queue and update neighbor in-degrees.
</thought>
<execute>
def topological_sort(graph):
    in_degree = {u: 0 for u in graph}
    for u in graph:
        for v in graph[u]:
            in_degree[v] += 1
    queue = [u for u in in_degree if in_degree[u] == 0]
    res = []
    while queue:
        u = queue.pop(0)
        res.append(u)
        for v in graph[u]:
            in_degree[v] -= 1
            if in_degree[v] == 0:
                queue.append(v)
    return res
</execute></bot>
